comment: Perks the player chooses at every 3rd level (every 4th with the Skilled trait). id: perk number. name and description: shown in the game (when missing, text/english/game/perk.msg is used; the demo's has placeholders only). ranks: how many times it can be taken (0 = not offered). level: lowest character level. requires: lowest SPECIAL values. skill: lowest skill value. bonus: a derived stat raised for every rank (meleeDamage, carryWeight, sequence, healingRate, criticalChance, damageResistance, radiationResistance, poisonResistance, actionPoints, armorClass, maxHitPoints or a stat number). Other effects are built into the engine.

perks.name: Awareness
perks.description: Examining a living creature also tells you its exact hit points and the weapon it holds.

perks.name: Bonus HtH Attacks
perks.description: Unarmed and melee attacks cost one action point less.

perks.name: Bonus HtH Damage
perks.description: Each rank adds 2 points of melee damage.

perks.name: Bonus Move
perks.description: Each rank gives 2 free action points every combat turn, for movement only.

perks.name: Bonus Ranged Damage
perks.description: Each rank adds 2 points of damage to every ranged attack.

perks.name: Bonus Rate of Fire
perks.description: Ranged attacks cost one action point less.

perks.name: Earlier Sequence
perks.description: Each rank adds 2 to your Sequence, so you act earlier in combat.

perks.name: Faster Healing
perks.description: Each rank adds 1 to your Healing Rate.

perks.name: More Criticals
perks.description: Each rank adds 5% to your chance of a critical hit.

perks.name: Night Vision
perks.description: Each rank lets you see 10% better in the dark, which also lowers the darkness penalty to hit.

perks.name: Presence
perks.note: Not offered: it improves reaction rolls, which the demo's scripts do not use.
perks.description: People react better to you when they first meet you.

perks.name: Rad Resistance
perks.description: Each rank adds 15% radiation resistance.

perks.name: Toughness
perks.description: Each rank adds 10% resistance to normal damage.

perks.name: Strong Back
perks.description: Each rank lets you carry 50 more pounds.

perks.name: Sharpshooter
perks.description: With each rank, ranged attacks treat the target as 2 hexes closer.

perks.name: Silent Running
perks.description: You can run while sneaking.

perks.name: Survivalist
perks.description: Each rank adds 25% to your Outdoorsman skill.

perks.name: Master Trader
perks.description: Adds 25% to your Barter skill.

perks.name: Educated
perks.description: Each rank gives 2 more skill points at every new level.

perks.name: Healer
perks.description: With each rank, First Aid and Doctor heal more hit points.

perks.name: Fortune Finder
perks.note: Not offered: it finds more money in random encounters, which the demo does not have.
perks.description: You find more money in random encounters.
